wardenRebuild.greaterRigDefect: 182 sole vertices carried a lower_leg/foot weight split of 0.65/0.35, one hundredth under the composer's 0.35 foot-region threshold, so the toe read as a shin plate on the floor and vetoed the stance sink. Knees held at 163 deg, sink capacity 0, left planted reach 0. Fixed by handing skin below the ankle to the foot plus a 0.005-unit pelvis drop on pinned ankles. Knees now 139 deg against the wayfarer's 137-142.
wardenRebuild.landingRule: Both packs install under /assets/weapon-lab/wardens/ as their own review entries. The shipped Warden GLBs are byte and checksum pinned and are never overwritten.
wardenRebuild.turnHeading: Rebuilt turns bake 90 deg into the root bone; the runtime now folds that onto the actor as the clip finishes while the pivot cancels what the fading action still poses. Shipped clips encode no turn and are skipped by measurement, not by name.
